name: opc
description: Connect Codex to your OPC Suite workspace. Manage contacts, sales orders, inventory, accounting, HRM, payroll, projects, expense claims, and documents — all from natural language inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HR & expense claims via AI — one-click OAuth, no token setup
interface.longDescription:
OPC Suite is an all-in-one business operations platform for SMBs. With this plugin Codex can read and write contacts, leads, deals, sales orders, quotations, products, inventory, suppliers, purchases, accounting (P&L, balance sheet, journals, AR/AP), HRM (employees, leave, attendance), payroll, projects, support tickets, expense claims and the documents library — all gated by the scopes you grant.

🔐 ONE-CLICK OAUTH: After install, run `codex mcp login opc` and Codex opens your browser to OPC's secure consent page. Pick the scopes you want to grant, click Approve, and you're connected — no token copy-paste, no environment variables. Codex Desktop triggers this flow automatically the first time the agent calls an OPC tool.

Every tool call is audit-logged with the calling agent, latency, and status; you can revoke access anytime from Settings → Developer.
